# moodle-cli 0.7.1

Fixes MCP clients receiving only counts such as "Found 5 Moodle courses" instead of the actual course data.

All eleven tools now expose their complete validated result as JSON text in `content`, alongside the same `structuredContent`. Clients that consume only text can read course names, IDs, deadlines, grades and forum data, then use those IDs in follow-up calls. File metadata is readable in text; file bytes remain in their embedded resource without duplication. Tool descriptions explain course ID handoffs and deadline timestamp units.

Managed deployment now verifies model-visible results and follows `list_courses` to `get_course` using the returned ID. A summary-only response fails deployment acceptance even if its structured data is correct. Tests cover every tool's text output, deadlines, forums, stdio, and an OAuth course-to-activity chain in real workerd.

## Upgrade

```bash
npm install -g moodle-cli@0.7.1
moodle mcp deploy
```

Installing the CLI alone does not update an existing remote Worker. Existing OAuth connections can continue using the updated tools after their Worker is upgraded; this patch does not change token or session storage formats.
